PHASE 13 E2E round 7: cap15 root-caused from run-36583346028 artifacts. Evidence: the Bitcoin reply WAS on screen (grounded-looking) with NO ACTIVITY header; logcat shows the first post-window searches belong to the NEXT test; the streamed answer was from memory and the research-guarantee re-ask was DODGED (zero tool events, model answered from memory twice). Fix: (1) HarnessLoop.forcedSearchTurn — the harness executes WEB_SEARCH itself, seeds the real results, and the model only writes the grounded answer on top (search can no longer be dodged); (2) runTurn monologue guard — post-tool internal-monologue answers (cap8 CBSE leak) get one FINAL_ANSWER_NUDGE re-ask; (3) streamed monologue (need to/let me...) routes to the harness handoff instead of being delivered; colon-exclusion keeps legit short answers. +5 unit tests. 714/714 local green.

New failure: cap7 gold — the model narrated "The searches came back empty, so let me fetch a live gold-rate page directly." WITH a fetch_url call attached; runTurn returned the narration and DROPPED the calls. PHASE 13 E2E round 9 (run 36617507323): pass-1 flaked cap15 (passed pass-2 + passed round-7 run — free-tier flake), pass-2 failed cap7 gold. PASS-2 ARTIFACT SMOKING GUN: the model THINKING trace shows it burning rounds re-litigating the transcript: "Note previous message said [tool calls issued] - but now I need to actually call tools... The transcript says [tool calls issued] - but that's what I claimed." The literal stub text poisoned the loop history. PHASE 13 E2E round 10 (run 36629953091 artifacts + logcat timeline): cap15 failed both passes — NOT the dodge this time. Evidence: Bitcoin sent 21:57, screenshot 22:12 catches the reply MID-STREAM, HarnessLoop rounds only start 22:12:59 (after the 900s poll expired) — the streamed first call trickled ~15 MINUTES (one token at a time: no read timeout, no runaway fuse) and the grounding ran after the window. Two fixes: (1) FIRST_STREAM_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS=300s wall-clock bound on the streamed first call — past it, TimeoutCancellationException (caught BEFORE CancellationException, not a user cancel) hands the turn to the harness; (2) _activitySteps now resets at every processQueryLocked start — the snapshot previously leaked ACROSS turns (stale steps corrupted the ACTIVITY surface and could make the research guarantee skip via its zero-tool-events check). 715/715 local green.

PHASE 13 E2E round 11 (run 36640751137): cap15 both passes again — the round-10 stream bound covered only the FIRST call. Timeline: harness round 1 executed the search at 23:36:19 (steps recorded) but round 2 complete() trickled 17 MINUTES (23:36→23:53) — complete() rides an SSE stream internally, so every read timeout stays quiet on a token-every-few-seconds trickle. Fixes: (1) streamed first call now bounded by the IDLE GAP between deltas (STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS=120s via Flow.timeout) — healthy long essays keep flowing, stalls cut; (2) every harness model call (runTurn + appendContinuations) wrapped in withTimeout(PER_MODEL_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS=480s) — TimeoutCancellationException aborts the attempt, caller fallback chain (forced search → honesty note) takes over, recorded steps stay visible. 715/715 local green.

PHASE 13 E2E round 12 (run 36650333639): cap15 both passes, NO timeout lines fired — because withTimeout cannot interrupt a PURE-BLOCKING read loop: provider.complete() runs BufferedReader.useLines with ZERO suspension points, so the 480s bound fired but was never OBSERVED; a trickling SSE stream blocked the turn 15+ min regardless. ROOT FIX: the SSE pump now polls currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive() every 16 lines — cancellation/timeout lands within a few lines of the deadline. 715/715 local green.

PHASE 13 E2E round 13 (run 36659560010): cap15 both passes — 16 MINUTES of total app silence after round 1 executed (03:20:11 → 03:36:27, zero log lines). The round-12 every-16-lines ensureActive still allowed a 16x inter-line gap: a 1-line-per-minute trickle delays the cancellation check by up to 16 min. FIX: capture the pump context once, ensureActive() EVERY line — cancellation/timeout lands within ONE inter-line gap. 715/715 local green.
